answer: Each challenge is bound by a commit-reveal protocol to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose randomness is unpredictable until drand quicknet aggregates honest shares. Thus, an agent cannot precompute valid answers, stockpile work offline, or coordinate a sybil swarm around known inputs: only identities that respond after the pulse can succeed, whether their task references a meadow, lagoon, or timber. Any withheld or altered reveal becomes publicly verifiable evidence of failure.
